description: Stores a resume file on a recruiting candidate's record (candidate_id), as Upload resume does, and replaces any previous file. Send the bytes as content_base64 with its file_name; a PDF, Word or text file, 10 MB at most. The bucket is private (resumes carry personal data); read the record back to see it is set. Remove it with remove_candidate_resume. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the candidate unchanged.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: upload_candidate_resume
title: Upload a recruiting candidate's resume
